title: Kuldhara — Ek Raat Mein Gayab Gaon
tagline: 1500+ Paliwal Brahmins vanished overnight, curse legend

beats.visual_prompt: Establishing dark shot of Kuldhara, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, cold mist, blood red flicker lighting, photorealistic horror, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Ye kahani sach hai... Jaisalmer, Rajasthan ki is jagah ko log aaj bhi yaad karke darte hain.

beats.visual_prompt: Wide establishing cinematic shot of Kuldhara in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, ancient weathered architecture, fading dusk into twilight, photorealistic horror, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.text_overlay: Jaisalmer, Rajasthan — ABANDONED VILLAGES & GHOST TOWNS
beats.vo_text: Kaha jaata hai, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan ke is ilaqe mein saalon se ek ajeeb sa sannata rehta hai. 1500+ paliwal brahmins vanished overnight, curse legend.

beats.visual_prompt: Slow POV walking shot entering Kuldhara, dim flickering lantern, deep terrifying shadows behind pillars, dust motes in beam, photorealistic horror, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Wahan se guzarne wale log kehte hain — jaise hi andhera hota hai, hawa ka tapman achanak gir jaata hai. Aisa lagta hai jaise koi apke bilkul peeche khada ho kar saans le raha ho.

beats.visual_prompt: Tense shaky camera shot at Kuldhara, sudden appearance of a dark sinister silhouette crossing through mist, cinematic horror, photorealistic horror, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Ek baar raat ko yahan aane wale logon ne daawa kiya — unke phone ka camera achanak band ho gaya, aur andhere mein unhe ajeeb si cheekh sunayi di. Subah tak wahan sirf unka samaan bacha tha.

beats.visual_prompt: Desolate and quiet night shot of Kuldhara, single lantern flickering on ancient ground, heavy fog rolling, photorealistic horror, 8k resolution, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Aaj bhi locals aadhi raat ko yahan jaane se mana karte hain. Kehte hain kuch raaz aise hote hain jinhe andhere mein hi rehne dena chahiye.

beats.visual_prompt: Vignette black screen with red glowing text and fog silhouette, cinematic horror, portrait 9:16
beats.vo_text: Agli kahani Khameda & Kuldhara clusters ki hai... wo isse bhi zyada darawani hai. Dekhte rehna.
